name: Perps
docs: and docs at Core `packages/perps-controller/docs/` and the client's `docs/perps/`.
parityNote: Mobile is the reference implementation; do not copy Extension divergence back into Mobile.

controller-portability-core.title: Keep platform code out of the controller
controller-portability-core.prevents: The shared controller importing host code, or an app reaching into controller internals.

perps-math-comes-from-the-controller.title: Use the controller math
perps-math-comes-from-the-controller.prevents: Two clients showing different PnL, fees or liquidation prices.

shared-formatting-display-precision.title: Use the shared formatters
shared-formatting-display-precision.prevents: The same value shown with different digits on different clients.

missing-numeric-data-stays-undefined.title: Never turn missing data into zero
missing-numeric-data-stays-undefined.prevents: A missing price or balance shown or traded as zero.

protocol-abstraction.title: Keep venue logic behind the provider
protocol-abstraction.prevents: One venue leaking into shared code; orders or fills mixed up between venues.

pro-mode-ui-gating.title: Gate Pro screens on both flags
pro-mode-ui-gating.prevents: Pro screens silently not showing, or showing when off.

metametrics-events.title: Use the agreed analytics events
metametrics-events.prevents: Events that break dashboards or double-count.

sentry-tracing.title: Bound and close every trace
sentry-tracing.prevents: A flood of traces, or traces that never end.

connection-websocket-architecture.title: Own every connection and subscription
connection-websocket-architecture.prevents: Leaked sockets, extra connections, timers polling data that already streams.

data-flow-state.title: Reset state on account, network and form changes
data-flow-state.prevents: Old account, network or form data acted on as if current.

trade-flow-order-execution.title: Send the order the user confirmed
trade-flow-order-execution.prevents: An order sent with the wrong size, price, side or slippage.

navigation-entry-and-exit-parity.title: Cover every way in and out of a screen
navigation-entry-and-exit-parity.prevents: A back button that works from one entry and not another.

embedded-signer-boundaries.title: Protect the embedded signer
embedded-signer-boundaries.prevents: A signing key leaking out of a WebView.

test-layer-coverage.title: Write tests that fail when the code breaks
test-layer-coverage.prevents: Tests that pass with the wrong formula.

architecture-docs.title: Keep docs and code in agreement

mobile-trace-instrumentation.title: Trace every Mobile screen
mobile-trace-instrumentation.prevents: Screens with no performance trace, or traces that never end.

android-back-paths.title: Handle Android back
android-back-paths.prevents: Android hardware back skipping a dialog.

mobile-test-layers.title: Exercise the real order flow in tests
mobile-test-layers.prevents: Order flows tested with everything mocked.

mobile-controller-integration-mocks.title: Keep the controller mocks current
mobile-controller-integration-mocks.prevents: A controller bump that breaks hand-written mocks unnoticed.

mobile-ui-structure.title: Keep logic out of components
mobile-ui-structure.prevents: Logic buried in components where tests cannot reach it.

native-modal-layout.title: Wrap Pro bottom sheets in a Modal
native-modal-layout.prevents: A bottom sheet clipped in the Pro layout.

magic-strings-magic-numbers-placeholder-.title: Use named constants
magic-strings-magic-numbers-placeholder-.prevents: Hard-coded values that drift from the controller constants.
